testCases.title: Positive: Customer navigates to Wishlist via My Account dashboard sidebar
steps: Click the "Wishlist" link in the dashboard sidebar

expectedResult.domState: Page heading "My account - Wishlist" is visible

testCases.title: Negative: Unauthenticated user directly requesting the Wishlist URL is redirected to login
preconditions: No auth storageState — fresh/guest browser context
steps: Navigate directly to /wishlist without logging in

expectedResult.urlState: Redirected to /login (exact redirect target to be confirmed at Stage 4)
expectedResult.domState: Login form is visible, Wishlist content is NOT visible

testCases.title: Positive: Customer navigates to Wishlist via the header navbar wishlist icon
steps: Click a.header-link-wishlist (the header wishlist icon) from the homepage

expectedResult.domState: Page heading "My account - Wishlist" is visible

testCases.title: Edge: Header wishlist icon navigates correctly from a non-home page
preconditions: Customer is on a product detail page
steps: From a product detail page, click the header wishlist icon

expectedResult.domState: Page heading "My account - Wishlist" is visible

testCases.title: Positive: Wishlist page displays a product card with item details and a remove action for one saved product
preconditions: Product id 63 ("Cream", testdata/wishlist-management/seed.json) has been added to the wishlist as setup

expectedResult.domState: One product card is visible showing product name "Cream — Authentic Korean Beauty Wholesale Product with Premium Quality Assurance", price "$33.00", a "Remove" button, and an "Add to cart" button

testCases.title: Positive: Wishlist page displays one card per saved product for multiple items
preconditions: Two products (id 63 "Cream" and "/gel-cream") added to the wishlist as setup

expectedResult.domState: Two distinct product cards are visible, one per product, each with its own Remove action

testCases.title: Negative: Unauthenticated user cannot view populated Wishlist content directly via URL
preconditions: No auth storageState — fresh/guest browser context
steps: Navigate directly to /wishlist without logging in

expectedResult.urlState: Redirected away from wishlist content (to /login — confirm at Stage 4)
expectedResult.domState: No product cards or wishlist content are visible

testCases.title: Edge: A discontinued/out-of-stock product in the wishlist renders without breaking the page
preconditions: A wishlist item exists whose product has since been discontinued or gone out of stock (requires a product fixture confirmed at Stage 4)

expectedResult.domState: Page renders without a crash/blank screen; the item either shows an out-of-stock indicator or is gracefully omitted (exact handling to be confirmed at Stage 4)

testCases.title: Boundary/Edge: Wishlist with a large number of items (20+) renders without breaking layout
preconditions: 20+ products added to the wishlist as setup

expectedResult.domState: All items render (paginated or scrollable, per actual site behavior) without layout breakage

testCases.title: Positive: Empty wishlist displays "Your wishlist is empty." and a working "Browse products →" button
preconditions: Customer's wishlist has zero items (default state of the shared test account per testdata/wishlist-management/seed.json)

expectedResult.domState: Text "Your wishlist is empty." is visible; a "Browse products" button/link is visible

testCases.title: Edge: "Browse products →" button navigates to the home page
Positive: Clicking "♡ Wishlist" on a product card adds the product with a success message
preconditions: Product id 63 ("Cream") is not currently in the wishlist
On a page showing the product card, e.g. /search?q=cream
steps: Click the "Add to wishlist" button on the product card (#add-to-wishlist-button-63)

expectedResult.urlState: No navigation (AJAX, stays on current page)
expectedResult.domState: Bar notification reads "The product has been added to your wishlist" (verbatim — see memory/decisions.md D-010)
expectedResult.dataState: Product 63 is now present in the customer's wishlist

testCases.title: Positive: Clicking "♡ Wishlist" on the product detail page adds the product with a success message
preconditions: Product id 63 ("Cream") is not currently in the wishlist
steps: Click the "Add to wishlist" button on the product detail page

expectedResult.domState: Bar notification reads "The product has been added to your wishlist"
expectedResult.dataState: Product 63 is now present in the customer's wishlist

testCases.title: Confirmed: Re-adding an already-wishlisted product shows the same success message and increments the header count, but does NOT create a duplicate grid entry
preconditions: Product id 63 ("Cream") is already in the wishlist
steps: Click the "Add to wishlist" button on the same product again

expectedResult.domState: Bar notification reads "The product has been added to your wishlist" again (same as the first add) — see memory/decisions.md D-011
expectedResult.dataState: Wishlist grid (/korean-wishlist) still shows exactly 1 product card for product 63 (confirmed: 1 button.wishlist-remove-btn, not 2). The header span.wishlist-qty count DOES increment again on this repeat add (e.g. (1) -> (2)), which no longer matches the actual number of visible product cards (1). This is a confirmed discrepancy flagged to the product owner in D-011, not a test-design guess — do not assert header-count == visible-card-count as a general invariant.

testCases.title: Edge: Rapid double-click on "Add to wishlist" does not create a duplicate entry
preconditions: Product id 63 ("Cream") is not currently in the wishlist
steps: Double-click the "Add to wishlist" button on the product detail page in rapid succession

expectedResult.dataState: Wishlist contains exactly 1 entry for product 63, not 2

testCases.title: UI+API: Add-to-wishlist AJAX request returns 200 and reflects in the DOM without a full page reload
preconditions: Product id 63 ("Cream") is not currently in the wishlist

expectedResult.domState: Header wishlist count and bar notification update in place

testCases.title: Positive: Header wishlist count increments by 1 immediately after adding a NEW product not previously in the wishlist
preconditions: Header wishlist count is known before the action (e.g. (0))
The product being added is NOT already in the wishlist (see D-011 for the repeat-add case, covered separately by TC-014)
steps: Add a product to the wishlist

expectedResult.domState: span.wishlist-qty inside a.header-link-wishlist increments by exactly 1 (e.g. (0) -> (1))
expectedResult.dataState: Wishlist item count matches the displayed header count for this first-add case (see D-011: this equivalence does NOT hold after a repeat add of the same product)

testCases.title: Edge: Header wishlist count decrements by 1 immediately after removing an item
preconditions: At least 1 product is in the wishlist
steps: Click "Remove" on a product card on the Wishlist page

expectedResult.domState: span.wishlist-qty inside a.header-link-wishlist decrements by exactly 1
expectedResult.dataState: Wishlist item count matches the displayed header count
